questions.stem: A 45-year-old man complaining of pain in the right flank has been diagnosed with right-sided renal calculi measuring 2.2cm. Urine microscopy finding is shown in the image. What is the most suitable treatment among the following in this patient?
questions.stemHtml: A 45-year-old man complaining of pain in the right flank has been diagnosed with right-sided renal calculi measuring 2.2cm. Urine microscopy finding is shown in the image. What is the most suitable treatment among the following in this patient?

options.label: C
options.text: No treatment required just pain management suffices
